objective: Extend the working directional slope/curvature forecast to one actual cached decoding step, complete relevant memory and all24 block interfaces; measure geometry and small-plane direction interaction.

questions.text: Why does a glass window become misty when warm moist air touches a cold surface?
A shelf holds 5 packets of 8 labels. If 9 labels are used, how many remain?
Choose is or are: The notes beneath the photograph ___ hard to read. Reply with the verb only.
All cedar boxes are sealed. No sealed box is empty. Can a cedar box be empty? Answer yes or no.
What does [4, 7, 9][1] return in Python? Reply with the value only.
Give one practical first step for preparing a small community garden before planting.

directions.kind: fresh orthonormal Gaussian directions projected off study13 span; fixed across calibration/held questions

cached_contract.position: First cached token after the normal full prefix
cached_contract.token: Normal-prefill greedy token, frozen before any intervention; if EOS use fixed760. Force the same token for all variants, not free-running generation.
cached_contract.state: Clone actual complete incoming KV/convolution/recurrent cache on every evaluation; verify caller cache hash unchanged. Forecast every outgoing cache tensor that can depend on the intervention. Verify unchanged prefix KV and all unaffected earlier-layer outgoing state hashes.
cached_contract.boundary: block11 input before RMSNorm/attention on current cached token
cached_contract.precision: FP32 promoted stored weights; original model operations/reference kernels unchanged

trajectory.activation_fields: Input residual, mixer branch, after-mixer residual, MLP branch and block output at all24 blocks, plus final hidden
trajectory.memory_fields: Current-token K/V for full-attention layers>=11; full convolution and recurrent states for linear-attention layers>=11; complete incoming cache retained and unaffected outgoing state hashed

derivatives.prefer: One exact nested directional-AD compatibility attempt at first calibration point; use only if practical and numerical calibration passes
derivatives.fallback: Forward-AD slopes plus a symmetric central difference of slopes for curvature. If forward AD is unsupported, symmetric value differences. For cache classes whose forward tangents fail calibration, use value-based finite differences for that class. All choices locked on calibration only.
derivatives.selection: Largest adjacent coarse/fine pair passing both calibration questions and directions. Use fine-step numerical coefficients when needed. No probe equals target endpoint strengths. No method/step changes after held outcomes.

numerical_gates.failed_held_validation: Retain frozen forecast and collect bounded diagnostics; primary support fails, no retuning or silent exclusion.

primary_support.zero_response_fields: Record unchanged/zero status; not evidence of resolved prediction accuracy.

optional_stress.purpose: Localize where large-push error accumulates; separate diagnostic, not primary or remedy.

optional_mixed_plane.before_outcomes: Freeze all plane forecasts before mixed endpoints; difference/weighted directions are not differentiated or fitted
optional_mixed_plane.compare: Full two-dimensional quadratic response versus diagonal/no-cross approximation
optional_mixed_plane.limits: Two reused contexts within this fresh phase, one held question; no extra independent family or full-space spectrum claim.
optional_mixed_plane.admission: Only with>=25 calls,300 native seconds and4GiB free; preserve skipped status otherwise.

preservation: Study13 primary success and study12 primary failure unchanged. Old monitor stopped. Record complete phase/cumulative ledgers, forecasts before outcomes, all probes/attempts, compact incremental checkpoint/export. No automatic giant sweep or kernel/library change.
limits: Only one cached position and one intervention site, conditional on a normal fixed prefix/cache and forced token.
All24 interfaces are observed but earlier blocks are causally unchanged; not all intervention sites or all internal gates tested.
Directional samples/mixed plane are not a full-space spectrum or semantic dictionary.
Numerical state derivatives, if used, require neighborhood probes and must be reported as approximate.
Information-geometric cost/derivative identities are not physical conservation/equilibrium.
No speedup/compression advantage claimed without a measured comparison; plane forecasts can reuse coefficients for unprobed directions.
